name: @graspy/server
description: graspy backend on Cloudflare Python Workers: DSPy generation pipelines and a DSPy ReAct tutor over A2A.

scripts.preinstall: if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv sync; else echo 'uv not installed - skipping Python sync'; fi
scripts.worker:dev: npm --prefix ui run build && uv run pywrangler dev
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check src tests scripts && uv run ruff format --check src tests scripts
